title: English Practice Quiz 0986
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: If you heat ice, it ___.
questions.explanation: The zero conditional uses present simple for general truths.

questions.question: I enjoy ___ books.
questions.explanation: Enjoy is followed by a gerund (-ing form).

questions.question: She ___ in this hospital for five years.
questions.explanation: The present perfect can describe a situation continuing to the present.

questions.question: Read: 'Please keep the floor dry to prevent accidents.' What is the instruction?
questions.explanation: The notice instructs people to keep the floor dry.
